eventName: Fifth Year ? One Lakh Palm Seeds Planting Festival (Phase 6 Field Activity)
eventDescription:
In this green celebration, 750 students enthusiastically participated and planted palm seeds for the first time in their lives.
Every palm seed gently placed into the earth by these young children will one day provide shade and hope for future generations.
With a deep love for nature and a firm commitment to nurturing greenery, this Palm Seed Festival organized by the Vidhaigal Volunteer Organization has sown seeds of environmental awareness in the hearts of all who participated.
